|game_text='''0 side — Infiltration'''

''Deploy Nar Shaddaa, Undercity and Scoundrel's Luck.'' '''For''' reminder of game, your gamblers, information brokers, and spies are scoundrels. You may not deploy Nightfall or cards with ability except scoundrels and [Independent] starships. "Luke" on opponent's [Reflections II] objective is treated as "Rebel Agent." Once per turn, may ▼ a battleground site to Nar Shaddaa. '''While''' this side up, your Force drains at systems are -1. May use 1 Force to ▲ Imperial Navigation Charts. '''Flip''' this card if Imperial Navigation Charts is 'stolen.'

'''7 side — Unlikely Allies'''

'''While''' this side up, your scoundrels are forfeit +1. Your Force generation is +1 for each battleground you occupy with a scoundrel (to a maximum of +2). "Once" on [[Scoundrel's Luck]] is treated as "twice." During your control phase, may retrieve 1 Force. Once during your turn, may place a card from hand in your Used Pile or Lost Pile, shuffle that pile and take the top card into hand. '''Flip''' this card if Imperial Navigation Charts is not on table (unless you have completed a [Virtual Block 8] Kessel Run).
|errata_history=This is the original printed text; the images are the release-sheet copy of the front ([[:File:VL-history-1281-44-front-sheet.png]]) and the Players Committee card image of the unchanged back. The later errata version is [[Infiltration / Unlikely Allies (Errata)]] (PC-E1, the current text). The picture-only slip crops ([[:File:VB8-00-Infiltration_Unlikely_Allies.png]], [[:File:VB8-07-Infiltration_Unlikely_Allies.png]]) and the original-card strips ([[:File:VB8-p8-48-Undercover.png]], [[:File:VB8-p8-49-Sometimes_I_Amaze_Even_Myself.png]]) show no game text.
* '''Original''' (this page): text as given in the Virtual Block 8.1 release sheet (official text as of 11 May 2012)<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock8_1">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock8_1.pdf#page=8 Virtual Block 8.1 release sheet] ("Official text as of 11 May 2012"; the surviving copy was re-made 18 July 2012), page 8, slip 45 (position on the sheet; the slip prints no number). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261027095418/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock8_1.pdf#page=8 Internet Archive]</ref>. Front: “Deploy Nar Shaddaa, Undercity and Scoundrel's Luck. For reminder of game, your gamblers, information brokers, and spies are scoundrels. You may not deploy Nightfall or cards with ability except scoundrels and [Independent] starships. "Luke" on opponent's [Reflections II] objective is treated as "Rebel Agent." Once per turn, may ▼ a battleground site to Nar Shaddaa. While this side up, your Force drains at systems are -1. May use 1 Force to ▲ Imperial Navigation Charts. Flip this card if Imperial Navigation Charts is 'stolen.'” Back: “While this side up, your scoundrels are forfeit +1. Your Force generation is +1 for each battleground you occupy with a scoundrel (to a maximum of +2). "Once" on Scoundrel's Luck is treated as "twice." During your control phase, may retrieve 1 Force. Once during your turn, may place a card from hand in your Used Pile or Lost Pile, shuffle that pile and take the top card into hand. Flip this card if Imperial Navigation Charts is not on table (unless you have completed a [Virtual Block 8] Kessel Run).” The release-sheet copy of the front ([[:File:VL-history-1281-44-front-sheet.png]], exact crop of sheet p. 8) prints it; the back is printed by the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB8-L-unlikelyallies-pre.gif]]). The PC website card list (2012–2013) shows no text for this card.
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Infiltration / Unlikely Allies (Errata)]]): the Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013, Light Side p. 47)<ref name="ml-ls">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_LS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Light Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). You may not deploy Nightfall or cards with ability except scoundrels and [Independent] starships. "Luke" on opponent's [Reflections II] objective is treated as "Kyle Katarn." Once per turn, may ▼ a battleground site to Nar Shaddaa. While this side up, your Force drains at systems are -1. May use 1 Force to ▲ Imperial Navigation Charts. Flip this card if Imperial Navigation Charts is 'stolen.'” The back is unchanged. The Players Committee card images ([[:File:VB8-L-infiltration-pre.gif]], [[:File:VB8-L-unlikelyallies-pre.gif]], undated) print it.
